title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Morning... so if I put something out there like “there’s more smoke than fire to James Shields and Tigers rumors,” that’s accurate.
And - not for use - but why? Does he want more than you guys have left
Questioned “And - not for use - but why? Does he want more than you guys have left”
I was the runner up for that job. I’m devastated but I appreciate you letting me put you down as a reference
Don’t worry you are where you are supposed to be now.
No quotes. We have checked on Shields, however, I don’t think we are not going to sign him. It has nothing to do with money as we never discussed money.
